content.short: CyberConnect is a decentralized social network protocol.
content.description: CyberConnect is a decentralized social protocol that centers identity sovereignty to support mass adoption and network effects. It enables profiles on EVM-compatible blockchains to anchor users' decentralized identities. With CyberConnect, users own their social graph, content, monetization channels, and social data, enabling seamless travel across multiple dApps without rebuilding their networks on each platform. This approach supports cross-app continuity of a user's identity, graph, and monetization across the ecosystem.
